WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescopes
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg, b.overall_avg
  FROM station_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.station_avg > b.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(station_avg - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM above_baseline;
